answer: Proposal: a buyer prepays one image-label batch containing velvet fabric, quartz crystals and a mesa landscape; each category has a buyer-signed acceptance test. Proposed validators pay one verified delivery from that batch escrow, burn a fixed audit fee, and mark its ID spent. The cheapest farm shares one model and self-orders with borrowed cash: it recovers only its own deposit minus the burned fee. Each extra profitable key needs a distinct outside-funded batch; splitting one batch among clones adds no revenue. Missing tests or replayed IDs forfeit that payout.
